plugin_kb.title: Knowledge Base
plugin_kb.description: The AI's source of truth for live chat: upload txt/md documents to be split and embedded automatically; the AI answers only from this content and hands off to a human when nothing matches
plugin_kb.uploadDesc: txt / md plain text only (≤2MB); documents are split and embedded automatically after upload
plugin_kb.uploadHint: Organize content as FAQs or self-contained paragraphs: blank lines become natural chunk boundaries; use the test question box below to verify retrieval after upload
plugin_kb.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its chunks will be removed and the AI will no longer answer from it.

fields.title: Title
fields.thresholdHint: 0~1, higher is stricter: if the best score falls below it, the AI declares "cannot answer" and hands off
fields.topKHint: Max knowledge chunks injected per answer (1~10)
fields.systemPromptHint: e.g. "keep answers within three sentences", "use a friendly tone"
fields.systemPromptNote: Style hints only; the hard rule "answer from the material only, admit when unknown" cannot be changed here

plugin_kb.settingsDesc: Tune when the AI admits it doesn't know, and how it sounds
plugin_kb.missingEmbed: Embedding is not enabled: configure an Embedding model under System Settings → Advanced → AI first, or uploads will fail
plugin_kb.missingChat: Chat model is not configured: complete the AI settings under System Settings → Advanced → AI first, or the AI cannot answer
plugin_kb.empty: No documents yet: upload product notes or FAQs so the AI can answer customer questions from them
plugin_kb.askPlaceholder: Ask like a visitor to verify the AI answers from the knowledge base
plugin_kb.askHandoff: No trustworthy match in the knowledge base — live chat would politely explain and hand off to a human, never fabricate
